svg.title: Short and long length forms
svg.desc: A length under 128 fits in one byte with the top bit clear. Otherwise the first byte has the top bit set and says how many length bytes follow: 82 01 52 means two bytes follow, 0x0152 = 338.

text.tspan: DER: always the shortest form. "81 05" is legal BER, illegal DER
and "80" (indefinite length, ends with 00 00) is banned outright
